profile_text.body:
Anthropic is a for-profit startup founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its site presents Claude as its AI, described as built for problem solvers and aimed at complex challenges, data analysis, writing code, and hard thinking work.

The company's tracked products center on Claude, listed as a general LLM assistant, alongside Anthropic Console, an API management console with prompt testing, evaluation tools, usage monitoring, and cost controls, and Claude Code, described as agentic coding with source-code exposure. A fourth product, Computer Use (Anthropic), is listed as a computer control agent for desktop automation, with system access and high-privilege operation risk noted. An MCP entry, ai.getvda/llm-orchestration-agent-langchain-anthropic, is described as an LLM Orchestration Agent (Langchain Anthropic).

Anthropic's litigation exposure is concentrated in California, with 236 matters there. Named cases span the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit (Edelson, PC, et al. v. Anthropic, PBC) and district courts including N.D. California (Patel, Smith, Pascual, Shakespeare, and Kahn v. Anthropic, PBC), D. Delaware (Haugland v. Anthropic PBC and University of Tennessee Research Foundation v. Anthropic PBC), D. Hawaii (Gribble and Haugland v. Anthropic PBC), D. Vermont (Brunell v. Anthropic PBC), and E.D. Pennsylvania (Grossinger v. Anthropic, PBC).
